item.description:
🛠 Tech Stack / 技术版图

  • Human: English, Japanese, Chinese
  • AI-Native: Prompt Engineering, Agentic Workflows, LLM Orchestration

Tools & Environment / 工具与环境

  • OS: macOS
  • Editor: Cursor / VS Code (AI-Augmented) / Emacs / Vim
  • AI Core: Claude, GPT-4o, DeepSeek
  • VCS: Git (GitHub/GitLab)

👤 Biography / 个人简介

AI-Augmented Fullstack Engineer / AI 增强型全栈工程师

Based in ShenZhen, I explore the intersection of traditional software craftsmanship and the emerging frontier of Artificial Intelligence. I believe that in the AI era, the role of an engineer shifts from a “code constructor” to an “intent translator and system architect.”

我目前在深圳工作，致力于将传统的软件工匠精神与人工智能的前沿技术相结合。我认为在 AI 时代，工程师的角色已从“代码构建者”转变为“意图翻译官与系统架构师”。

In my spare time, I am a digital philosopher, a video game enthusiast, and a builder of side projects that aim to simplify complexity.
